subject.title: When calling a VLLM model, the usage page statistics show no data. How can I calculate usage and cost when using VLLM?

question: Should this vLLM Usage-page report stay open for reporter/runtime evidence, or should maintainers classify the remaining cost-only part under the unknown-pricing issue?
rationale: Current main already has the intended vLLM streaming-usage and Usage-page aggregation paths, but only maintainer judgment can decide whether the existing evidence is enough to treat the report as a support/pricing duplicate instead of waiting for a fresh repro artifact.

options.title: Wait for evidence
options.body: Keep this issue open until a current-main vLLM run provides raw stream, transcript, Usage API, screenshot, and pricing evidence that identifies the failing boundary.

options.title: Fold cost-only behavior into pricing issue
options.body: If the reporter confirms tokens are present and only spend is missing, route the remainder to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90674 and close this as overlapping.

options.title: Document vLLM pricing setup
options.body: If maintainers decide the only gap is operator setup, add clearer vLLM pricing guidance and close the issue as support after linking the docs.

recommendation.title: Wait for evidence
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a current-main vLLM run provides raw stream, transcript, Usage API, screenshot, and pricing evidence that identifies the failing boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: He committed the current vLLM streaming-usage and usage-cost paths, so he has the clearest history for deciding whether the evidence is enough to route or close.
